messages:
alina.partnerships: Quick thread  Marketplace onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure + optional hardware add-on. Need final publisher IDs, SKU matrix, trial UX decision (no-CC vs CC), and short legal blurbs. Partner preview in 9 days.

tom.legal: For no-CC trials we need: abuse controls, opt-in billing prompt before conversion, and refund language for auto-convert cases. I'll draft EN/DE/FR snippets and the DPA link today.

ravi.product: SKU proposal: `redwood-saas-starter` (14d, metered), `redwood-saas-scale` (monthly + overage), `redwood-edge-addon` (one-time). Recommend bundle SKU `redwood-saas-plus-edge`. Metering unit = per-10k-token-block.

alina.partnerships: Can we confirm publisher IDs? AWS sandbox, GCP partner, Azure tenant. Who's owning activation?

lucy.ops: AWS sandbox ID = RBW-AWS-SBX-92 (verified). GCP publisher request submitted (portal ticket #GP-4312). Azure tenant pending; MS contact assigned. Webhook endpoints required: `/marketplace/provision` and `/marketplace/entitlements`. Ensure TLS client certs for vendor callbacks.

marco.marketing: Asset ask: hero (1200x400), 12s demo GIF, 60-char headline. Suggest: "Ship LLM features with predictable cost & latency." Need co-brand guidance if hardware partner included.

tom.legal: Policy notes: AWS requires data residency toggle if we offer EU-only processing (`eu_data_only`). Also redact PII in provisioning logs; add privacy blurb in listing linking to DPA.

ravi.product: Draft manifest snippet (non-validated):

```
{
  "offerId": "redwood-inference-offer",
  "publisherId": "<vendor-publisher_id>",
  "skus": [
    {"id": "redwood-saas-starter", "pricing": "metered", "trialDays": 14},
    {"id": "redwood-saas-scale", "pricing": "subscription"},
    {"id": "redwood-edge-addon", "pricing": "one_time"}
  ],
  "metadata": {"eu_data_only": false, "supports_vpc_peering": true}
}
```

lucy.ops: I'll run the AWS private-offer upload tonight and post validation output. If GCP complains about unknown metadata keys, I'll open infra ticket. Also: set publisher contact to infra@redwood.com across portals.

marco.marketing: For the listing short copy: "14-day trial, then $0.00035 per token unit (10k = $3.50)." Will refine once product confirms. Also need a short SI blurb: "Certified partners available for migration & install."

alina.partnerships: Action items: 1) @tom.legal finalize localized T&C + DPA link (due Wed 12:00 UTC). 2) @ravi.product lock SKU slugs + pricing and provide invoice example lines (due Tue EOD). 3) @lucy.ops complete AWS sandbox private-offer test + GCP manifest submission (due Mon midnight). 4) @marco.marketing deliver hero + GIF + headline (due Thu EOD). Follow-up sync next Wed 9:30am PT in #partnerships for sign-off.

upload-bot: assets:upload queued (job id: amp-20260701-09). ETA 2026-07-01T19:00Z.

lucy.ops: Upload complete: `manifest_validation: OK` for AWS; GCP returned warning `metadata key edge_addon trimmed`. Ravi please change `edge_addon` -> `edge_compatible`.

ravi.product: Adjusting manifest now. Will push PR with quickstart curl examples and invoice sample lines (`10k token units x price`).

alina.partnerships: Thanks team. I'll draft the partner preview packet once legal and product items land. If anything blocks publisher activation ping me directly. :thumbsup:
